title: Swarajists And No Changers
definition: The ideological split within the Indian National Congress (INC) post-Gaya Session (1922) regarding the strategy to be adopted following the withdrawal of the Non-Cooperation Movement.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a perennial favorite for Prelims (ideological differences, key leaders, election results) and Mains (evolution of constitutional struggle vs. mass movement).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Swarajists And No Changers.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
